allow_list_unavailable.message: The allow list of the Nintendo Switch has not been loaded yet. Try again after the next update.

application_not_found.message: No application with ID {application_id} was found on the Nintendo Switch. Use the list applications action to find application IDs.

bedtime_alarm_out_of_range.message: {value} not accepted. Bedtime Alarm must be between {bedtime_alarm_min} and {bedtime_alarm_max}. To disable, set to {bedtime_alarm_disable}.

bedtime_end_time_out_of_range.message: {value} not accepted. Bedtime End Time must be between {bedtime_end_time_min} and {bedtime_end_time_max}. To disable, set to {bedtime_alarm_disable}.

bedtime_out_of_range.message: The specified bedtime start or end time is outside of the allowed range. Please ensure bedtime start is between {bedtime_alarm_min} and {bedtime_alarm_max}, or {bedtime_alarm_disable}, and bedtime end is between {bedtime_end_time_min} and {bedtime_end_time_max}.

daily_playtime_out_of_range.message: {value} minutes is not accepted. The daily playtime limit must be between 0 and 360 minutes, or -1 to remove the limit.

device_error.message: The Nintendo Switch rejected the change: {error}

extra_playing_time_active.message: Extra playing time is currently active. Please wait until it expires before updating daily restrictions.

extra_playing_time_active_settings.message: Extra playing time is active for today. Settings can't be changed until it expires.

invalid_device.message: The specified device is not a Nintendo device.

invalid_device_state.message: This change is not possible with the current restriction mode of the Nintendo Switch.

invalid_entity.message: The selected sensor is invalid, make sure you are selecting a Nintendo Parental Controls sensor.

invalid_pin_length.message: The PIN code must be a 4 to 8-digit number between 0000 and 99999999.

invalid_player.message: The selected sensor is not a player sensor entity. Make sure you have selected the used screen time sensor for a specific player.

no_devices_found.message: No Nintendo devices found for this account.

requires_daily_restrictions.message: Daily restrictions can only be set when restriction mode is set to different for each day.

update_required.message: The Nintendo Switch parental controls integration requires an update due to changes in Nintendo's API.

data_description.playing_holdover: Nintendo does not report what is being played right now, so play is inferred from screen time growing. Consoles upload their screen time every few minutes, so the playing sensors stay on for this long after the last increase.

add_bonus_time.description: Add bonus screen time to the selected Nintendo Switch.

bonus_time.description: The amount of bonus time to add in minutes. Maximum is 30 minutes, minimum is 5.
bonus_time.name: Bonus time

device_id.description: The ID of the device to add bonus time to.
device_id.name: Device

add_bonus_time.name: Add bonus time

key_by_player_id.description: Key the report by player ID, with each player's nickname and apps inside, instead of by nickname. Use this when two players can have the same nickname.

entity_id.name: Player

player_usage_report.name: Get player usage report

set_app_allowed.description: Adds an application to, or removes it from, the allow list of the selected Nintendo Switch. Allowed applications can be played regardless of the console's age rating restriction; play time limits still apply. The allow list applies to everyone on the console. Optionally returns the application's new state.

allowed.description: Whether the application is on the allow list.
allowed.name: Allowed

application_id.description: The Nintendo application ID, as returned by the list applications action.
application_id.name: Application ID

device_id.description: The ID of the device to change the allow list on.
device_id.name: Device

set_app_allowed.name: Set application allowed

update_daily_restrictions.description: Updates restrictions for a specific day of the week on the selected Nintendo Switch.

bedtime_end.description: The time from which play is allowed. Must be between 05:00 and 09:00.
bedtime_end.name: Bedtime end

bedtime_start.description: The time when bedtime restrictions start. Must be between 16:00 and 23:00, or 00:00.
bedtime_start.name: Bedtime start

day_of_week.description: The day of the week to update restrictions for.
day_of_week.name: Day of the week

device_id.description: The ID of the device to update daily restrictions for.
device_id.name: Device

max_play_time.description: The maximum playtime allowed in minutes for this day (0 to 360).
max_play_time.name: Max playtime

update_daily_restrictions.name: Update daily restrictions

update_pin_code.description: Updates the PIN code for the selected Nintendo Switch.

device_id.description: The ID of the device to update the PIN code for.
device_id.name: Device

pin.description: The new PIN code. Enter a 4 to 8-digit PIN between 0000 and 99999999.
pin.name: PIN

update_pin_code.name: Update PIN code
